rows.why: The Contributor-Covenant 'Consequence: A temporary ban...' paragraph is byte-identical at the same line span (100-104) in the root CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and in packages/docs-v3/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, i.e. a whole-file copy where the docs-v3 copy could be replaced by a pointer to the root file.

The 'examples of unacceptable behavior' bullet list (sexualized language, trolling, harassment, publishing others' private information) is word-for-word the same in both CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md copies at lines 30-37 — the duplicated bullets are prose content, not merely list shape.

The 'Our Pledge' paragraph ('We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge...') is identical character-for-character in the root and docs-v3 CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md at lines 5-10, a straight copy of the same governance document into two paths.

The 'Scope' paragraph about representing the community with an official e-mail address or social-media account is identical in both CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md files at lines 53-57; one copy plus a reference would carry the same information.

Two adjacent commented-out revisions of the same ZodObject.merge method in one file (lines 2701-2735 and 2743-2763) whose bodies are copied verbatim — the same 'const merged: any = new ZodObject({ unknownKeys, catchall, shape: () => objectUtil.mergeShapes(...), typeName })' block appears twice, only the generic signature differing.

The 'Consequence: A warning with consequences for continued behavior...' enforcement paragraph is identical at lines 88-93 in both the root and docs-v3 CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, another paragraph of the same wholesale-copied document.

The disabled test('assignability') block was copy-pasted from the v3 test file into the v4 test file and then drifted slightly (line-wrapped signature, 'return { [key]: valueSchema }' itself commented out, util.assertEqual swapped for expectTypeOf) — the same dead test carried in two places rather than a maintained mirror.

The 'examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment' bullets (empathy and kindness, respecting differing opinions, accepting constructive feedback, apologizing, focusing on the community) are identical prose in both CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md copies at lines 20-26.
